page.overview:
What is Largo Baggins?

Largo Baggins was a hobbit of the Shire and the great-grandfather of Frodo Baggins.

Largo Baggins was born in the year TA 2820 (SR 1220). He was the fourth son of Balbo and Berylla Baggins. Largo had three older siblings – Mungo, Pansy and Ponto and a younger sister Lily. He married Tanta Hornblower and they had a son, Fosco, born in TA 2864 (SR 1264). Largo died in 2912 (SR 1312).
